title: Italian Spicy Patatas Bravas
description: A twist on the classic Spanish tapas dish, with an Italian flair and spicy kick.
instructions: 1. Cut the potatoes into 1-inch cubes and place them in a bowl of cold water to soak for 30 minutes.
2. In a separate bowl, mix together the falafel crumbs, olive oil, garlic, red pepper flakes, salt, and Italian seasoning.
3. Drain the potatoes and pat them dry with paper towels.
4. Add the potatoes to the falafel crumb mixture and toss to combine.
5. Heat about 1/4 cup of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
6. Add the potatoes to the skillet and cook for about 5-7 minutes on each side, until crispy and golden brown.
7. Serve the Spicy Patatas Bravas hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
